description: Make an individual sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit). Needs an SFXMint API key on an account with AI-made sounds left in a pack: each take uses one AI-made sound per started 5 seconds, charged when it starts, and failed takes are given back. Without a key or AI-made sounds it answers with buy_url; the user decides whether to buy, an agent never pays. Returns WAV files (16-bit stereo, 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz as sample_rate asks; signed links valid 15 minutes) with SHA-256, MP3 (128 kbps) through the same link with ?format=mp3, and ogg_url; if they are not ready within about 25 seconds, it returns the order id for get_generation. Not CC0: the user may use them in their own projects, commercially, but not redistribute them as standalone sound files or in a sound collection. AI-generated: the user should listen before use.

duration_s.description: Length of each take in seconds; leave it out and SFXMint chooses from the description. Each started 5 seconds uses one AI-made sound a take.

follow.description: How closely the takes follow the words: variety (default, for a short description), balanced, or close (for a detailed one); same price

prompt.description: What should be heard, in plain English (other languages are translated), at most 400 characters: the source, the action, the material, how it starts and ends. Mention only sounds to be heard.

sample_rate.description: The WAV's sample rate: 44100 (default) or 48000, the rate video and most game engines mix at; 16-bit stereo either way; same price

variations.description: How many takes (default 2); each is charged

name: generate_sound
